issue: i am a professor in a college and wanted to setup a claude lti key for my students
subject: Claude for students
response: To set up a Claude LTI key for your students, follow these steps: 1. In Canvas, sign in as an administrator and navigate to Admin -> Developer Keys. 2. Click "+ Developer Key" then "+ LTI Key." 3. Enter the required information including Key Name, Description, Redirect URIs, Title, Target Link URI, OpenID Connect Initiation Url, and JWK method. 4. Toggle Privacy Level to Public. 5. Add placements like 'Course Navigation' and 'Assignment Edit.' 6. Click 'Save' and toggle the state to On. 7. Go to Admin -> Settings -> Apps, click 'View App Configurations,' select '+ App,' choose 'By Client ID,' input the Client ID, and click 'Install.'
justification: The provided evidence outlines the steps necessary to set up the Claude LTI integration in Canvas, which is relevant to your request as a professor looking to create an LTI key for students.
